name: Stack-Based Terrain Representation (SBRT)
aliases: Representación de Terrenos Basada en Stacks
definition: A compact 3D terrain data structure that generalizes heightmaps by storing a vertical sequence of intervals (stacks) for each (x,y) coordinate, where each interval consists of a start height and an attribute (e.g., material type). It solves the high memory footprint of voxel-based representations and the inability of 2.5D DEMs to model complex internal structures like caves or overhangs.
summary: Stack-Based Terrain Representation is a compact 3D data structure storing vertical intervals per coordinate to model complex internal structures, using 1D-like textures for better prefetching performance than single-texture approaches.
